title: A leaving gift for someone moving abroad
body:
The problem with leaving gifts

Someone who moves abroad has one suitcase and a strict weight limit. Every heavy, fragile or bulky gift becomes a problem the night before the flight. At the same time this is exactly the moment people want to give something that matters. The answer is a gift that is either light, or that is sent straight to the new address.

What they will miss

People who emigrate rarely say they miss things. They miss places: their street, the bakery on the corner, the route along the river, the office where they spent ten years. A good leaving gift brings a little of that along.

Six ideas that travel well

  1. A map of home. The city, the neighbourhood or the street they are leaving, with a pin on their old front door or on the office.
  2. A letter from everyone. Ask friends or colleagues for one short line each and bind them together. It weighs almost nothing.
  3. A taste of home, in small portions. The coffee, the liquorice or the spice mix they will not find over there.
  4. A first evening in the new city. A voucher for a restaurant near their new home, so the first night is not spent alone between boxes.
  5. A recipe book from home. Your family dishes or their favourite dishes from the neighbourhood, written out.
  6. A plan for the first visit. Put a date in the calendar together. It makes the goodbye lighter.

How to make a map of home

1. Choose what home means to them

For some it is the whole city, for others one street or a village. For a colleague, the area around the office with the lunch spot and the station works well. Zoom out for a city, zoom in for a neighbourhood.

2. Mark the places

Add a house on their old address, a heart on the café where your group always met, or a star on the office. A few pins tell the story better than a long text.

3. Write the words

  • The name of the city with its coordinates
  • A line such as Where it all began or You can always come home
  • The years they lived there, for example 2014 to 2026

4. Send it ahead

This is the real advantage of a print. Instead of adding weight to their luggage, have it delivered framed to their new address. We print to order close to the customer and ship free to Europe, the United Kingdom and the United States, so it can be waiting for them when they arrive. Choosing a size? See our guide to sizes and frames.

A gift from a group

For colleagues or a group of friends, a larger framed print, 50×70 cm, is a gift you can share the cost of. Write everyone's names in the small line under the title, or slip a card with all the messages into the parcel.

summary: When a friend, a colleague or a child moves to another country, the best gift is light to carry and heavy with meaning. Six ideas, and how to give them a map of the place they are leaving behind.
